text: SUPERVISOR COMMIT ORDER: commit your stranded camera-bridge + rect-cap work NOW — uncommitted work is not acceptable. The files are contaminated with other lanes' edits, so use HUNK-LEVEL staging: git add -p (or git add -p <file>) and stage ONLY your own hunks — the camera-input bridge lines (framework/game/camera.zig + the game-camera binding + engine/primitive wiring you added) and the rect-cap raise in cart/hmsc-int/game/physics.ts. Do NOT stage the neighbor lanes' unrelated hunks in those same files. Verify with git diff --cached that only YOUR lines are staged, then commit with a message listing what's in it. If two logical changes (camera bridge vs cap), make two commits. Report the SHA(s) + the staged hunk summary. Leave reqs in review.
